reason: On March 28, 2013, Custom Spine, Inc. issued a minor removal of a lot of 18 screws that were found to be out of specification.  The screw length was 5 mm shorter in length than the required specification for the screw size. The product is laser marked 8.5mm X 45mm, but its length measured 40mm.
product_description:
Custom Spine ISSYS LP Inverted Screw System.  8.5MM X 45 MM ISSYS LP Screw Rx Non-Sterile.  Custom Spine, Inc. 9 Campus Dr. Parsippany, NJ  07054 USA.  TEL: 973-808-0019

The ISSYS LP Spinal Fixation System is intended to help provide immobilization and stabilization of spinal segments as an adjunct to fusion of the lumbar and/or sacral spine for pedicular and non-pedicular fixation.
